title: Find Two Non-Repeating Elements

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: Number of elements in the array

parameters.name: out1
parameters.description: Output pointer for the smaller unique value

parameters.name: out2
parameters.description: Output pointer for the larger unique value

constraints: Exactly two elements appear once; all others appear exactly twice
Elements can be any valid int32_t value (including negative, zero, INT_MIN, INT_MAX)
